menus.note: Lunch or dinner; last orders 8.30pm. Wine pairing is one glass per course (€275 with wine). Service and taxes included.

menus.name: centenary menu (Menu Anniversaire)
menus.note: Until the end of 2026, to mark the restaurant's 100 years; six courses with the caviar dish €375. Book by email at least a week ahead.

menus.name: lunch menu
menus.note: Wednesday to Saturday, for the whole table. Optional extra courses (Ardennes ham mousse +€28, cheese +€19); wine €55 for four courses, €68 for five. Only three courses after 1pm.

bookingOpens: Online through the booking link on the restaurant's reservation page. For last-minute tables, phone.
groups: Four private rooms, including a table d'hôte in the kitchen, for private dinners and events. Groups of six or more choose the same menu for everyone. Private meetings followed by lunch can be arranged.
duration: Guests arrive between 12pm and 1pm or 7pm and 8.30pm; the restaurant closes at 4.30pm after lunch and around midnight after dinner.
